description: Pass rule of the bench (runbook 7.2 step 8), applied by `report <run> --bench <this file>`. comparable: canaries that a blind check of the same material caught (each must be caught by its own lens); hinted: canaries the lens checklists point at (at least hintedMin caught by their own lens); falseFindings: quotes of two claims a blind check wrongly flagged as errors, which must not end open.
